phrases.en: I need a SIM card.
phrases.zh: 我需要一张 SIM 卡。

phrases.en: Do you have eSIM?
How much for a week?
Can you help me install it?

dialogue.en: Hi, I need a SIM card.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我需要一张 SIM 卡。

dialogue.en: Prepaid or monthly?
Prepaid. How much for a week?
Twenty dollars for ten gigabytes.
Good. Do you have eSIM?
Yes, for the same price.

phrases.en: Does this plan work in Canada and Mexico?
phrases.zh: 这个套餐在加拿大和墨西哥能用吗？

phrases.en: Can I keep my Chinese number active?
How do I activate the eSIM?
Is there a data-only plan?
Can I top up online?

dialogue.en: Does this plan work in Canada and Mexico?
dialogue.zh: 这个套餐在加拿大和墨西哥能用吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, it includes North America roaming.
Good. Can I keep my Chinese number active?
dialogue.zh: 好。我能保留中国号码吗？

dialogue.en: Use dual SIM and turn off data roaming on your Chinese line.
dialogue.zh: 用双卡，关掉中国卡的数据漫游。

dialogue.en: How do I activate the eSIM?
Scan this QR code in your settings.
dialogue.zh: 在设置里扫这个二维码。

dialogue.en: Okay. Is there a data-only plan?
The data-only plan is fifteen dollars.
Great. Can I top up online?
Yes, through the carrier app.

phrases.en: My phone is carrier-locked. Can you check if it will work with your network?
phrases.zh: 我的手机有运营商锁。能查一下能不能用你们的网络吗？

phrases.en: I need a plan with a US phone number for bank verification.
phrases.zh: 我需要一个带美国号码的套餐用于银行验证。

phrases.en: Does the eSIM support 5G on my model?
phrases.zh: eSIM 在我的机型上支持 5G 吗？

phrases.en: Can I transfer the eSIM to a new phone?
phrases.zh: 能把 eSIM 转到新手机吗？

phrases.en: What's the cancellation policy for the monthly plan?
phrases.zh: 月租套餐的取消政策是什么？

dialogue.en: My phone is carrier-locked. Can you check if it will work with your network?
dialogue.zh: 我的手机有运营商锁。能查一下能不能用你们的网络吗？

dialogue.en: I'll check the IMEI against our network bands.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下 IMEI 和我们的频段。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I need a plan with a US phone number for bank verification.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我需要一个带美国号码的套餐用于银行验证。

dialogue.en: The monthly plan includes a US number.
Good. Does the eSIM support 5G on my model?
dialogue.zh: 好。eSIM 在我的机型上支持 5G 吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, if your phone is 5G-capable.
Great. Can I transfer the eSIM to a new phone?
dialogue.zh: 好。能把 eSIM 转到新手机吗？

dialogue.en: You can transfer it once per billing cycle.
Okay. What's the cancellation policy for the monthly plan?
dialogue.zh: 好。月租套餐的取消政策是什么？

dialogue.en: Cancel anytime before the renewal date.

phrases.en: What's the password for the Wi-Fi?
I can't connect.
Is Wi-Fi free here?
Which network should I choose?

dialogue.en: Hi, what's the password for the Wi-Fi?
It's on the receipt.
Thanks. I can't connect.
Choose the guest network and enter the password.
Is Wi-Fi free here?
It's free for customers.

phrases.en: The Wi-Fi keeps asking me to log in again.
phrases.zh: Wi-Fi 一直让我重新登录。

phrases.en: Is there a time limit?
Can I connect my laptop too?
Is the connection fast enough for video calls?
Where is the router?

dialogue.en: The Wi-Fi keeps asking me to log in again.
dialogue.zh: Wi-Fi 一直让我重新登录。

dialogue.en: Try forgetting the network and reconnecting.
Okay. Is there a time limit?
Two hours per session.
Can I connect my laptop too?
You can connect up to three devices.
Good. Is the connection fast enough for video calls?
It's usually fine in the lobby.
Thanks. Where is the router?
Behind the front desk.

phrases.en: The Wi-Fi is blocking my VPN. Can you whitelist the port?
phrases.zh: Wi-Fi 屏蔽了我的 VPN。能放行端口吗？

phrases.en: I need a wired connection for a work call. Is there an Ethernet port?
phrases.zh: 我需要有线连接开工作电话。有网口吗？

phrases.en: The guest network is overloaded. Is there a priority network?
phrases.zh: 访客网络过载了。有优先网络吗？

phrases.en: Can I get a static IP for remote access?
phrases.zh: 能给我静态 IP 用于远程访问吗？

phrases.en: The Wi-Fi certificate warning keeps appearing. Is the network secure?
phrases.zh: 一直出现 Wi-Fi 证书警告。网络安全吗？

dialogue.en: The Wi-Fi is blocking my VPN. Can you whitelist the port?
dialogue.zh: Wi-Fi 屏蔽了我的 VPN。能放行端口吗？

dialogue.en: I'll ask IT to open the VPN ports.
dialogue.zh: 我叫 IT 开放 VPN 端口。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I need a wired connection for a work call. Is there an Ethernet port?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我需要有线连接开工作电话。有网口吗？

dialogue.en: There's one under the desk in the business center.
dialogue.zh: 商务中心桌子下面有一个。

dialogue.en: Great. The guest network is overloaded. Is there a priority network?
dialogue.zh: 好。访客网络过载了。有优先网络吗？

dialogue.en: Members get the priority network.
Okay. Can I get a static IP for remote access?
dialogue.zh: 好。能给我静态 IP 用于远程访问吗？

dialogue.en: That requires a business account.
I see. The Wi-Fi certificate warning keeps appearing. Is the network secure?
dialogue.zh: 明白。一直出现 Wi-Fi 证书警告。网络安全吗？

dialogue.en: It's secure, but the certificate expired yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 安全，但证书昨天过期了。

asks.en: Do you need the Wi-Fi password?
asks.zh: 您需要 Wi-Fi 密码吗？

asks.en: Are you looking for Wi-Fi?
The network is called Hotel Guest.

listening.pattern: Do you need…? / Are you looking for…? / The network is…

asks.en: Is it asking for a password?
Try disconnecting and reconnecting.
The Wi-Fi is down right now.

listening.pattern: Is it asking…? / Try… / The Wi-Fi is…

You'll need to log in again after an hour.

phrases.en: My data isn't working.
I have no signal.
Can you check my plan?
How do I turn on data roaming?

dialogue.en: My data isn't working.
Is data roaming on?
I don't know. How do I turn on data roaming?
dialogue.zh: 不知道。怎么开数据漫游？

dialogue.en: Go to settings, then cellular, then data roaming.
dialogue.zh: 设置、蜂窝网络、数据漫游。

dialogue.en: Okay. I have no signal.
Try restarting your phone.

phrases.en: I used up my data. Can I add more?
Why is my connection so slow?
Can you check if there's an outage in this area?
phrases.zh: 能查一下这区域有故障吗？

phrases.en: Do I need a new SIM card?
phrases.zh: 需要换新 SIM 卡吗？

phrases.en: Can I switch to a faster plan?

dialogue.en: I used up my data. Can I add more?
I can add five gigabytes for ten dollars.
Good. Why is my connection so slow?
You may be in a congested area.
Can you check if there's an outage in this area?
dialogue.zh: 能查一下这区域有故障吗？

dialogue.en: There's maintenance on the nearest tower.
Okay. Do I need a new SIM card?
dialogue.zh: 好。需要换新 SIM 卡吗？

dialogue.en: No, your SIM is fine.
Good. Can I switch to a faster plan?
dialogue.zh: 好。能换成更快的套餐吗？

dialogue.en: The premium plan has priority data.

phrases.en: My phone shows full bars but no internet. Is the APN setting wrong?
phrases.zh: 手机满格但没网。APN 设置错了吗？

phrases.en: I'm being charged for roaming even though I bought a local plan.
phrases.zh: 我买了本地套餐，但还在收漫游费。

phrases.en: The hotspot won't turn on. Is tethering blocked on this plan?
phrases.zh: 热点打不开。这个套餐限制共享吗？

phrases.en: I need a temporary number for two-factor authentication. Can you help?
phrases.zh: 我需要一个临时号码做双重验证。能帮忙吗？

phrases.en: My eSIM disappeared after the phone update. Can you reissue it?
phrases.zh: 手机更新后 eSIM 不见了。能重新发吗？

dialogue.en: My phone shows full bars but no internet. Is the APN setting wrong?
dialogue.zh: 手机满格但没网。APN 设置错了吗？

dialogue.en: Let me send you the correct APN settings.
dialogue.zh: 我给您发正确的 APN 设置。

dialogue.en: Thank you. I'm being charged for roaming even though I bought a local plan.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我买了本地套餐，但还在收漫游费。

dialogue.en: Turn off data roaming on your home SIM.
Okay. The hotspot won't turn on. Is tethering blocked on this plan?
dialogue.zh: 好。热点打不开。这个套餐限制共享吗？

dialogue.en: Tethering is included, but you need to enable it in settings.
dialogue.zh: 共享包含，但要在设置里开启。

dialogue.en: Good. I need a temporary number for two-factor authentication. Can you help?
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要一个临时号码做双重验证。能帮忙吗？

dialogue.en: A prepaid number can receive verification codes.
dialogue.zh: 预付费号码能收验证码。

dialogue.en: Great. My eSIM disappeared after the phone update. Can you reissue it?
dialogue.zh: 好。手机更新后 eSIM 不见了。能重新发吗？

dialogue.en: I'll generate a new QR code for you.
